brief.headline: Apollo’s £5.7bn easyJet takeover faces union opposition
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: Apollo’s proposed acquisition of easyJet has drawn opposition from European unions, although the airline expects the £5.7bn deal to complete by the end of Q1 2027, according to a report by Reuters.

AI & Technology: BlackRock attracted $15.3bn in private markets inflows during the third quarter, exceeding analyst expectations of $12.2bn, as the firm expanded its financing activities and deployed capital from its AI infrastructure fund, according to a report by Yahoo Finance.
Hedge Funds: U.S. spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds recorded $261.4 million of net outflows on Wednesday, October 14, according to Farside Investors.
AI & Technology: On Inside Blackstone, host Christine Anderson sits down with SoftBank founder and CEO Masayoshi “Masa” Son.
Family Offices & Wealth: Reports from DeVoe, Piper Sandler and Fintrx show a lighter third-quarter deal market, but the analysts see no signs of slowing among capital-backed RIA consolidators.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits. The S&P 500 stands at 7,718.94 (down 1.1% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 16.9, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.21% (down 3 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.37 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.25%, near long-run norms (up 9 bps on the prior reading).
